claims.text: LQTS w resting QTc >470 ms: a BB = recommended.
claims.quote: In patients with long QT syndrome with a resting QTc greater than 470 ms, a beta blocker is recommended

claims.text: Preferred: a long-acting, nonselective BB (eg, nadolol, slow-release propranolol).
claims.quote: When a beta-blocker is used, a long-acting, non-selective beta-blocker (eg, nadolol, slow-release propranolol) is preferred.

claims.text: Acute congenital LQTS TdP: IV BB rather than IV isoproterenol.
claims.quote: Unlike medication-induced acquired torsade de pointes, the mainstay of acute IV pharmacotherapy is IV beta-blocker rather than IV isoproterenol.
